prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-end fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on the edge of a standalone white marble bathtub in a luxury resort spa bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with softly waved blonde hair, calm confident expression, natural skin texture, and supplied gold accessories. She wears a supplied metallic-pink high-fashion mini dress with an asymmetrical neckline, high side slit, and tasteful midriff cut-out, plus gold clutch and strappy sandals.
composition_elements: Full-length dramatic low-angle portrait with the subject seated on the bathtub edge, leaning slightly back, one hand on the tub, legs crossed in a strong editorial stance.
White marble tub with floating rose petals, misty steam, green plants and tall frosted windows.
Preserve metallic pink reflections, supplied accessories, tub, spa elements, and clean luxury hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden ambient light with controlled cinematic highlights, soft shadows, gentle steam diffusion, and premium spa atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 3:4 portrait, 50mm lens at f/4, realistic skin and metallic fabric detail, physically plausible marble, water, petals and steam, subtle film grain, balanced color grade, no text or watermark.
